title: Copy destination register
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, the destination-register map assigns a register among $0$ through $16$ to each copy site. It sends the radius and logarithm copies to register $4$, each indexed addition copy to register $5$, the width-counter copy to register $13$, both base-copy sites to register $7$, both access copies to register $10$, and the iteration copy to register $3$.
hypotheses_covered: Copy site; indexed additions use an index below $K_0$
